To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new inhibitor-of-apoptosis protein (IAP) is expressed in a cell-cycle-regulated fashion, and that this IAP is required for the maintenance of the mitotic checkpoint and for the prevention of apoptosis in the G2-M transition of the cell cycle.
the new IAP protein survivin is expressed in the late G2 phase of the cell-cycle, associates with microtuble structures during mitosis, and is required to prevent cell-death during mitosis.
the IAP, survivin, is a regulator of the cell cycle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of survivin in the cell cycle.
the molecular mechanisms underlying cell proliferation, cell death and the regulation of these processes.
the control of apoptosis in the cell cycle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
survivin is a novel cell-cycle-regulated inhibitor of apoptosis that controls the G2/M transition and is a potential therapeutic target in human cancer.
survivin may be a key regulator of the mitotic checkpoint and a critical determinant of the balance between cell division and cell death.
Survivin, an anti-apoptotic molecule, is a regulator of the mitotic cell cycle and a target of cancer therapy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
survivin is a cell-cycle-regulated inhibitor of apoptosis that controls the cell-cycle-dependent checkpoint that prevents entry into mitosis in response to apoptotic signals.

the expression of survivin in the G2 phase of the cell-cycle is required to prevent the activation of the mitotic checkpoint and apoptosis in the G2–M transition, and the expression of survivn during mitosis is required to maintain the microtubules in an active state to allow the progression of mitosis.
survivin is an important anti-apoptosis factor that controls cell-cycle progression and cell death during mitosis.

survivin is a cell cycle regulated protein that associates with microtublules in mitotic spindle.
the cell cycle and cell survival are linked through the regulation of survivin.
